name: story-search-filters
title: Search filters story
description: Dot animation of a freshness calendar and domain and country filters.
usage: Search filters on a search product card (third of the Search page capabilities). Plays only on screen; shows its resting picture with reduced motion.
avoid: Stories as the main content of a page
notes: The last week of a calendar fills in while `last_week` is typed under it, then the filters beside it arrive in turn: the domains to include, one to exclude (crossed out), and a country.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
